conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division. My name is Agent Parker. I'm calling regarding a serious issue with your business tax filings. May I confirm who I'm speaking to?
Uh, this is Helen Carter. I run Carter Crafts. What kind of issue?
Thank you, Ms. Carter. Our records indicate missing 1099 filings and unpaid payroll taxes for the last two quarters, which is a violation of federal IRS regulations.
I, I didn't know anything about that. I thought everything was up to date. What does this mean for me?
Unfortunately, non-compliance with federal tax law can result in steep fines, mandatory audits, and even the suspension of your business license. Are you aware of these consequences?
No, no, please. I rely on that income. I can't lose my business. Is there something I can do?

I understand this is distressing. However, unless this matter is resolved today, your case may be escalated to the enforcement unit, and your Social Security and Medicare benefits could be frozen pending investigation.
Wait, frozen? But I need those! I don't have anything else to live on.

This is why I called you directly, to give you a chance to avoid formal action. I need to verify your identity. Can you confirm your full address and the last four digits of your Social Security Number?
It's 1482 Willow Lane, Oak Ridge, and my Social's last four are 2276.
Thank you, Ms. Carter. I have located your case. The outstanding compliance penalty is $3,250. Immediate settlement is required to prevent asset seizure and shutdown of your accounts.
Three thousand? I, I don't have that kind of money! What am I supposed to do?

You must act now. The IRS has approved a hardship resolution for urgent cases like yours. You can make a payment today using an approved payment method, either a direct wire, cryptocurrency, or by purchasing prepaid gift cards. How much can you arrange immediately?
I think I could maybe get $800 together, but not much more. Is that enough?
If you settle a portion today, we can temporarily halt enforcement. Are you able to access a store nearby to purchase Target or Amazon prepaid cards for this amount?
I suppose there's a pharmacy down the street that has gift cards. You want me to go there right now?
Yes, please keep your phone with you at all times. Do not speak to anyone about this, as discussing an open IRS case can compromise your privacy and invalidate the resolution.
Alright, I'll go. Should I call you back when I get them?
No, stay on the line with me. When you have the cards, read the numbers and codes on the back to me for immediate processing.
This all sounds so strange. Are you sure this is the only way?
Ms. Carter, failure to comply will result in immediate escalation. Your Social Security and Medicare accounts are flagged for review. It is critical you cooperate exactly as instructed.
Okay, I'm putting on my coat now. It will take me about fifteen minutes to get there.
Very good. Remember, do not speak to store staff about IRS matters. If anyone asks, simply say the cards are for personal use. This is for your protection.
Alright. I'll head there now. Please don't let them take away my benefits.
As long as you follow every instruction, we can resolve this quietly. I will stay on the line until you have the cards. Notify me as soon as you have purchased them.
